## What is a workspace?

Also asked as: Where does my work run? Is a workspace the same as a project?

A workspace is the connected environment where agents do their work. A
project is the body of work you select within that environment. Check both
names before approving changes; selecting a different workspace does not
automatically move your project there.
[Understand workspaces and agents](/docs/workspaces-and-agents).
